audit_items.proof_trace: All five state-changing handlers call accrue_interest (or a wrapper) before mutating protocol state: handle_mint calls it directly at L274, handle_withdraw calls refresh_obligation_assets_interest at L326 (covers all debt + collateral reserves), handle_borrow calls refresh_obligation_borrow_interest_with_new_borrow at L407, handle_repay calls it directly at L459, and handle_liquidation routes through liquidation_inner which calls refresh_obligation_assets_interest at L720. The reserve-level accrue_interest (reserve.move L131-135) is idempotent and the now timestamp is derived from Sui's on-chain Clock object (clock.timestamp_ms()/1000) which callers cannot manipulate.
